fieldData.description: To celebrate 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drink & food with your fellow Indian community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT! This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Free food, drinks for everyone.
